prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate ONE clearly labeled DESIGN BOARD with exactly THREE independent width specimens of the SAME existing DooKnow downloaded-backup restoration FILE-CHOICE DRAWER, never pretend three windows are simultaneously open in one app. External labels above product frames: DESIGN BOARD, A Desktop, B 390px, C 320px. Source roles/states are metadata; no other developer captions inside components. Straight-on neutral backdrop, no phones/browser/private parent rail/workspace. Supplied PILOT is STYLE ONLY: flat white/#f7f8fa, #272b3a/#657084 text, #e6e9f1 fine borders, #4566c6 primary, small8px radii and clear compact Chinese typography. Use approximately1600×1152 canvas so all3 natural-size frames and their complete fields/footers remain readable; no tiny thumbnails.
A is only the desktop right-drawer component approx760CSSpx width×1000height; B is complete390px-wide×844height component; C is complete320px-wide×780height component. Each genuine drawer has straight full-height white frame, header/body with its own scroll region and reachable fixed footer; no outer app/desktop chrome, no phone bezel, no additional window duplicated in any specimen. Narrow specimens wrap title/description/labels and native file control row if necessary, never remove fields/close/actions.
ALL3 selected SOURCE-DERIVED states identical: restoreBackup absent, restoreStep=choose, no selected backup or key, busy=false/error absent/dirty=false, help collapsed. Header undo icon, title 从备份恢复, exact description 在独立位置恢复并验证备份，当前知识库继续运行。, closeX enabled. Stepper source exactly 1 选择文件 active, 2 确认恢复 inactive. Body contains only two actual fields in order: 加密备份（最多 128 MiB） with native file-choice input 未选择文件; 恢复私钥（最多 16 KiB） with separate native file-choice input 未选择文件. Never display private-key content. Below retain collapsed 大文件与部署切换帮助 disclosure.
Footer exactly 取消 enabled plus primary forward-icon 下一步：确认恢复 ENABLED in every specimen. Actual template disables this button only while busy and validates empty/oversize file choices on activation; do not invent disabled-empty behavior. No confirmation-summary table/backup time/size/ID, no 上一步, no 上传并恢复独立副本 or 开始独立恢复 (later/other branch), no task/success/error/discard prompt simultaneously. No password/destination-path inputs, backend request/hash/cursor/CSRF fields, OS picker. Keep all3 source controls/guards and source field sequence, with readable 320/390 layout and no horizontal overflow; this static board does not prove runtime fit.
